decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - On completion of the installation, tests shall be carried out to confirm that light spillage conforms to the agreed design, with appropriate adjustments, realignment or shielding carried out as necessary, and thereafter permanently maintained.
Condition : 4 - On completion of the installation, an illuminance plot shall be carried out and submitted to the local planning authority.
description: Erection of lighting columns incorporating CCTV coverage to public footpath between Turnham Green Terrace & Upham Park Road.
